 Kansas Sweeps Monster Energy Big 12 Men’s Basketball Weekly Awards
 Story Links
 IRVING, Texas – Kansas swept this week’s Monster Energy Big 12 Men’s Basketball awards with Tre White being named Player of the Week and Tyran Stokes earning Freshman of the Week after the Jayhawks took down then-No. 24 Kentucky at the Champion’s Classic.
In Kansas' 89-69 win against the Wildcats, White scored a career-high 30 points on 11-of-16 shooting from the field. White went 4-of-6 from behind the arc, marking his 30th career game with multiple three-point makes, and the third time this season. White’s 30-point performance is his 18th career game with 20 or more points.
Stokes recorded the first double-double of his career with 23 points and 10 rebounds, both career highs. He was 8-for-19 from the field, including 4-for-8 from three-point range. His four assists in the win were also a career best. Stokes, a Kentucky native, leads Kansas in rebounds with a 7.3 average through three games and his 15.3 points per contest are second on the team.
Joining the Jayhawk duo on the Big 12 Starting Five is Arizona freshman Caleb Holt, who averaged 20.5 points for the week, including a 24-point performance in a win at Auburn. Holt’s performance helped the Wildcats snap Auburn’s 71-game non-conference home winning streak. Paulius Murauskas from Arizona State also garnered starting five recognition for the second-straight week on 26.5 points across two Sun Devil wins, including a 31-point, 13-rebound double-double. Cruz Davis led Texas Tech to a victory over then-No. 3 Illinois with 20 points, six assists, three rebounds and a steal. He has scored in double figures in all four Red Raider games this season.
 Big 12 Men’s Basketball Player of the Week 
Nov. 9 – Robert Wright III, BYU
Nov. 16 – Tre White, Kansas
 Big 12 Men’s Basketball Freshman of the Week 
Nov. 9 – Miles Sadler, West Virginia
Nov. 16 – Tyran Stokes, Kansas
